messages.author: 0111ed37d2662b85
messages.subject: feature request/inquiry: LKJ distribution
parts:
Many thanks to the developers and countless contributors for all the great work building this useful software.

I was wondering whether the NIMBLE team might considering implementing additional distributions on the space of SPD matrices. In particular, I would welcome support for the LKJ distribution (https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0047259X09000876). 

Best,
Henry

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Re: feature request/inquiry: LKJ distribution
parts:
hi Henry, indeed the LKJ distribution has come up as something we'd like to include. 
If anyone is interested in helping out with this, please let us know. 

In the interim, writing a user-defined distribution for such cases would be a good way to go.

Chris
